purpose: Document first-party local cadastral/registry evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official city map covers the full municipality, continuously updated and exports DWG/DXF/TAB/MIF; city charges its map fee. Lantmäteriet Fastighetsindelning Direkt includes property geometries and is free API, but requires legal-purpose review and product access. Public map viewer itself is not a verified anonymous full-feature endpoint.
registryAssessment: Göteborgs Stad explicitly maintains a continuously updated Fastighetskarta for all of Göteborg; Lantmäteriet documents property geometry datasets. The municipal Geodataavdelning is the specific local custodian.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Göteborgs Stad states the Fastighetskarta covers the entire municipality, is continuously updated and contains property boundaries, boundary points, designations and rights; formats include DWG, DXF, TAB and MIF; order by fee through Geodataavdelningen.
Lantmäteriet documents an API product containing property and joint-property geometries, daily updated and free, but subject to legal-use review and access provisioning; it is not a browser map.
Lantmäteriet describes access/legal provisions for high-value geodata products and APIs.
City open-data platform says API use requires registering an application/API key; inspected open-data catalogue did not list the cadastral Fastighetskarta as a free public dataset.
